proposal.reason: Main change isolates CE memcpy from ltOki DMA by reserving rings/queue IDs, gating OKI feature agreement across ranks, and updating CE stream/QP setup and launch behavior for mixed CE/OKI execution. Add enqueue because ordinary enqueue now applies capture-safe user-stream ring hints that affect collective/P2P launch paths. Add symmetric because device-side OKI AR/RS and P2P-DMA kernel logic was corrected for tail chunk sizing, broadcast pre-chunk clamping, and per-lane byte validity, which are substantive correctness fixes in symmetric collective execution.
